text:
alex: Quick sync: product asked for a concise launch checklist for the long-term routing/isolation work. We have customer asks for EU residency + cross-region failover. What's MVP?
mira: Minimal ship: region-affinity routing, tenant residency flag, per-tenant fallback toggle, and a canary rollout. No live migrations v1.
cal: Ops note: fallback impacts KV cache locality. For MVP we should default fallback to disabled for residency-locked tenants and provide a warmed-standby option for critical customers. Need telemetry for cache cold-warm deltas.
anya: Commercial: require documented customer agreement if they accept out-of-region fallback. Also need cost guardrails; naive failover could add ~20% infra spend.
alex: Proposed gating metrics before scaling: canary P95 <= 140ms, fallback error rate < 0.5%, cache-miss penalty median < 70ms, egress delta <= 12% forecast. Agree?
mira: Yes. Also require runbook + automated rollback + customer-facing console notice when a request goes out-of-region.
devops-bot: ticket created: ROUTE-821 prewarm job + canary flag `canary/route-affinity-v1`.
cal: I'll own infra experiments: prewarm, prefix-replication probe, and circuit-breaker on fallback paths.
anya: I'll draft SLA wording and pricing path for Dedicated if cost guardrail exceeded.
alex: Decision: opt-in pilot for cross-region fallback with explicit consent. Owners: mira (playbook), cal (infra), anya (commercial). Reconvene next Tue for sign-off.
